prompt: A young adult East Asian woman, upper-body close-up portrait, framed from above the chest to the top of the head. The subject is positioned slightly to the right of the center, body slightly turned to the left about 20 degrees, head gently turned toward the camera, eyes calmly gazing at the lens, with a restrained, elegant, and quiet expression, no intentional smile, lips naturally closed, conveying a high-end fashion magazine quality. She has an exquisite oval face, a smooth jawline, a fair warm-toned complexion, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, a slender nose bridge, and light nude-pink lips. The makeup is minimalist, featuring only thin foundation, natural eye makeup, light blush, and nude lip color. Real skin texture, fine pores, vellus hair, natural skin tone gradients, and soft highlights are preserved; plastic airbrushing is prohibited. Her long black hair is neatly parted in the middle and gathered in a low bun at the back of her head, smooth and sleek, with only a few fine strands naturally falling by her ears. She wears a pair of modern minimalist pearl earrings, a combination of silver metal and pearls, exquisite but not overly flashy. The clothing features a combination of high-end lingerie and a thin blouse: a white lace tulle bra with fine floral embroidery lace texture, draped with an ivory translucent chiffon or silk blouse that falls naturally over the shoulders, creating soft layers of lightweight fabric. The background is a pure creamy white gradient with no furniture or decorations, retaining only minimal spatial depth. The overall tone is high-key, low-saturation, and low-contrast Morandi colors, composed of white, cream, warm skin tones, and light gray. Soft natural window light shines from the front left, forming a very soft, large area of diffused light, with almost no harsh shadows on the face, natural catchlights in the eyes, and a gradually blurred background. The overall style presents a Japanese film, Fine Art, and fashion magazine cover aesthetic, being quiet, pure, and airy. Photography parameters: 85mm or 105mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes, creamy bokeh, realistic hair layers, real fabric fibers, real lace texture, natural skin micro-reflections, slight ISO 100 film grain, Kodak Portra 160 color bias, photorealistic, ultra-realistic, soft cinematic grading, editorial portrait photography. Avoid: plastic skin, AI airbrushing, HDR, high saturation, high contrast, exaggerated makeup, incorrect fingers, incorrect ears, deformed facial features, CG texture, anime style, cluttered background, furniture, text, watermarks, logos.

promptZh: 一张 年轻东亚女性 的上半身特写肖像，取景范围从胸部以上至头顶。主体位于画面中心偏右，身体向左微转约 20 度，头部轻微转向镜头，双眼平静地注视着镜头，表情克制、优雅且宁静，没有刻意微笑，双唇自然闭合，呈现出高端时尚杂志的质感。她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、流畅的下颌线、白皙且带有暖调的肤色、杏仁状的深褐色双眸、细长的自然眉形、挺拔的鼻梁以及浅裸粉色的双唇。妆容极简，仅有轻薄的底妆、自然的眼妆、淡雅的腮红和裸色唇妆。保留真实的皮肤纹理、细小的毛孔、绒毛、自然的肤色渐变以及柔和的高光；严禁塑料感的喷枪修图。她留着黑色长发，中分并于脑后扎成低发髻，顺滑整洁，仅有几缕发丝自然垂落在耳畔。佩戴一对现代极简风格的珍珠耳环，银色金属与珍珠的组合，精致而不张扬。服装采用高端内衣与轻薄衬衫的组合：一件 白色蕾丝薄纱内衣，带有精致的花卉刺绣蕾丝质感，外搭一件象牙白半透明雪纺或丝绸衬衫，自然地披在肩上，营造出轻盈面料的柔和层次感。背景为纯净的奶油白渐变色，没有家具或装饰，仅保留极小的空间深度。整体色调为高调、低饱和度、低对比度的莫兰迪色系，由白色、奶油色、暖肤色和浅灰色组成。柔和的自然窗光从左前方射入，形成非常柔和、大面积的漫射光，面部几乎没有生硬的阴影，眼睛中有自然的眼神光，背景呈现渐进式的虚化。整体风格呈现出日系胶片、艺术摄影和时尚杂志封面的美学，安静、纯净且通透。摄影参数：85mm 或 105mm 人像镜头，f/1.8，浅景深，焦点清晰，奶油般虚化，真实的头发层次，真实的面料纤维，真实的蕾丝质感，自然的皮肤微反射，轻微的 ISO 100 胶片颗粒感，Kodak Portra 160 色偏，照片级真实，超写实，柔和的电影级调色，编辑类肖像摄影。避免：塑料感皮肤、AI 喷枪修图、HDR、高饱和度、高对比度、夸张妆容、手指错误、耳朵错误、面部特征变形、CG 质感、动漫风格、背景杂乱、家具、文字、水印、Logo。
